asset: Glasdon Jubilee 110 litter bin, Thanet District Council livery

capture.device: Android 14 phone, rear camera, 1280x720 portrait, 30 fps playback (120 fps sensor)
capture.clip: bin-1.mp4, 9.15 s, 275 frames, handheld orbit at chest height
capture.frame_extraction: ffmpeg -vf fps=15 -q:v 1 -qmin 1, native resolution, no blur culling needed (blurdetect median 4.06, max 7.08)
capture.exif: none -- video frames carry no focal length; RealityScan solved it

photogrammetry.export: bin.obj, 253738 vertices / 507480 faces, 8192x8192 diffuse, Z-up, arbitrary units
photogrammetry.reconstruction_region: not tightened; car park, planter and passer-by removed in Blender

steps: crop to bin by ground-plane fit and radial gap (bin r<6.5, background r>30)
upright by wall-normal eigenvector (4.3 deg lean vs car park), squared by min-area rectangle, ground bisected
decimate 507k -> 100k, stubber hole cut r=1.8 with 1.0 skirt, sky-reflection hood recoloured
profile measured at 60 z-slices: body half-width 3.78 (n=5.2), bands 4.02-4.05 (n=3.4), hood 4.00, shoulder to plateau r=2.9 at z=14.85
apertures 4.0 x 2.0 at z=12.6 (all four faces agree), plates measured from the baked atlas
parametric superellipse shell rebuilt, scan texture baked (Cycles selected-to-active) then replaced by a generated stylised albedo

scale.method: uniform, matched to spec height (15.22 scan units incl. restored 0.37 foot); scan width/depth read +1.8% over spec
scale.proportion_check: scan 7.80:7.15 vs spec 598:553 -- the bin is rectangular, not square

texture: T_LitterBin_D.png 1024x512 sRGB, UV strip (u = around, v = up the profile), shared by all LODs
